summary: Iteration 15 — light re-verification pass for the three iter14 hardening tweaks (webhook explicit allow-sets, UPPERCASE category testids, support-role read-only cells). Backend: 19/19 green in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration15_advisory_fix_hardened.py. Every hardened advisory-fix contract confirmed on the LIVE preview URL: POST /api/webhook/email/resend → 503 {error:webhook_verification_failed, reason:webhook_secret_not_configured}; POST /api/webhook/email/sendgrid → 503 reason=webhook_public_key_not_configured; POST /api/webhook/payment/stripe (fake Stripe-Signature) → 503; POST /api/webhook/payment/razorpay → 503 reason=webhook_secret_not_configured; POST /api/webhook/payment/paystack → 503 reason=webhook_secret_not_configured; POST /api/webhook/payment/paypal → 503 reason=webhook_id_not_configured; unknown provider slugs still 404. Parametric guardrail confirmed on 6 routes: NEVER 500, NEVER 2xx. Support-role RBAC intact — POST /api/v1/admin/integrations/stripe/{test,disable} both return 403. Regression: fixture-ead /auth/me 200; billing checkout 200 with Stripe test-mode URL; providers count == 14 with the same status matrix (stripe=TEST_MODE, email_password/google_auth=CONNECTED, resend/sendgrid/twilio/elevenlabs/razorpay/paypal/paystack=CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED). Frontend POLISH-UPGRADE-1 verified on the live preview: all 7 category testids now UPPERCASE — data-testid=integrations-category-{AUTH,AI,PAYMENTS,EMAIL,SMS,VOICE,STORAGE} all present; the previously-emitted lowercase variants are NO LONGER in the DOM (confirmed by explicit lowercase probes returning 0). The 14 integration rows all still carry data-testid=integration-row-{slug}. POLISH-UPGRADE-2 verified: as support, the DOM contains 14 read-only <span> elements (one per row's Actions column) and integration-test-stripe / integration-toggle-stripe are NOT present in the DOM. Backend still enforces RBAC (403). POLISH-UPGRADE-3 verified: admin sees full Test + Disable buttons in every row; clicking Test on stripe drops the '✓ 0ms' result badge next to the buttons (Stripe test-mode call returned in <1 ms so the intermediate spinner was too fast to freeze-capture, but the result badge confirms the async round-trip landed and rendered correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: webhooks_email.py now uses an explicit set {webhook_secret_not_configured, webhook_public_key_not_configured} — good; the previous suffix-endswith('not_configured') widening risk is gone. If future error codes such as webhook_id_not_configured or auth_not_configured need 503 semantics for email providers, add them explicitly.

webhooks_payment.py splits into _SERVER_MISCONFIG_EXACT (exact match) + _SERVER_MISCONFIG_PREFIX (auth_failed*/upstream_error*) — the prefix branch is still slightly overloaded: 'upstream_error' semantically means 'PayPal API had a bad day' (transient 5xx from api.paypal.com), which is more of a 502/504 concern than 503 (server-misconfig). Consider distinguishing in the operator health log so alerting differentiates 'operator forgot to set PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID' from 'PayPal downtime'.
Admin.jsx now emits integrations-category-{cat.toUpperCase()} — casing is consistent with integrations-summary-{STATUS_UPPER}. Nice.
Admin.jsx Actions renders read-only for support role instead of visually-present-but-disabled buttons — good UX polish, reduces cognitive load; every mutation route is 403 backend-side anyway.

Preserve/document the read-only span testid convention (currently no data-testid on the read-only span) — worth adding data-testid=integration-actions-readonly-{slug} for future support-role automation tests. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 polish upgrades verified — uppercase category testids, support read-only cells, admin Test+Disable + result badge)
